```{r clear environment}
# clear environment for maximum reproducibility
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r load packages}
# load librarian (package for installing/loading packages)
if (!require("librarian")) install.packages("librarian")

# load requried packages
librarian::shelf(here, # relative file paths 
                 tidyverse, # data wrangling
                 BlakeRMills/MoMAColors, # color palette
                 
                 # PCoA
                 vegan,
                 
                 # IF WE RUN THE SEM
                 piecewiseSEM, # structural equation modeling
                 semEff, # indirect effect p-values
                 glmmTMB,
                 performance # check models
                 )
```

```{r explicitly assign functions if needed}
# make sure correct functions attached to the correct packages
summarize <- dplyr::summarize
group_by <- dplyr::group_by
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r set seed}
set.seed(0429)
```

# Set the color palette and graphics

```{r consistent color palette by treatment}
colorz <- moma.colors("Warhol", n=15, type="discrete")

b.color <- colorz[3]
control.color <- colorz[9]
crab.color <- colorz[1]
n.color <- colorz[6]
```

```{r set graphing theme}
# ggplot theme
theme_set(
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
    theme(text = element_text(size=20)) 
) 
```

# Read in data

```{r}
physiology_1 <- read_csv(here("data", "physiology.csv"))
metadata <- read_csv(here("data", "metadata.csv"))
```

# Join data

```{r}
physiology_1 %>% 
  inner_join(metadata) -> physiology_2
```

# Compute dissimilarity matrix

Get just the physio data

```{r}
physiology_2 %>% 
  select(protein_change, carb_change, endosym_percent_change, tissue_loss_5_percent) -> physiology_3
```

Compute the distance matrix

```{r}
distance_1 <- dist(physiology_3, method = "euclidean") # using Euclidean because data are negative (changes)
```

# Run PCoA

```{r}
library(ape) # somehow deals with the correction? Need to look into this
pcoa_res <- pcoa(distance_1) 
```

Scree plot

```{r}
# 3. Scree plot
scree_df <- data.frame(
  Axis = 1:length(pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig),
  Variance = pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig
)

ggplot(scree_df, aes(x = Axis, y = Variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "black") +
  geom_point(color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PCoA Axis", y = "Relative Eigenvalue",
       title = "Scree Plot of PCoA Eigenvalues")

# 4. Ordination plot of first two axes
ordination_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(pcoa_res$vectors),
  Axis1 = pcoa_res$vectors[, 1],
  Axis2 = pcoa_res$vectors[, 2]
)

ggplot(ordination_df, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, label = Sample)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkred", size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = paste0("PCoA 1 (", round(pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[1]*100, 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PCoA 2 (", round(pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[2]*100, 1), "%)"),
       title = "PCoA Ordination (Euclidean distance)")
```
